thread:
maya: Thanks for the great all-hands. Thread to capture the follow-ups on timing/scope for API / Console / Optimize. Please keep replies short so I can update comms.
tony: Quick recap from product: API GA (hosted) = target 2026-10-01 internal, 2026-10-15 public. Console revamp GA = 2026-11-30. Optimize beta = 2026-07-15. I'll own the public dates.
nina: Runtime note: Optimize beta relies on the KV-cache hotfix and batching refactor. KV hotfix PR #501 merged but we need canary runs; batching refactor ETA 2026-06-28.
harper: DevEx asks: sample migration guide + quickstart for Console admin flows. Can deliver initial draft by 2026-08-01. Will need product review.
omar: Leadership request: make API streaming + function calls the highest priority. If any Console features block API GA, we should decouple and ship API first.
julia: Sales ops request: can we provide a short one-pager for reps that outlines what to tell customers between July and Nov? Need by 2026-07-20.
tony: Agreed on decoupling. We'll scope Console GA to admin/rollouts + dashboards; non-blocking UI polish moved post-GA.
nina: For Dedicated customers: autoscale behavior change is on the same path. I'll surface a compatibility note for ops by 2026-07-05.
harper: I'll coordinate the sample apps with Solutions Eng and request a tech review slot 2026-07-12.
maya: Can engineering confirm 'go/no-go' for API GA by 2026-09-10 so marketing/sales can prep?
nina: Tentative yes. I'll confirm after the canary sweep on 2026-09-03. If issues, we'll open a blocker ticket and escalate.
julia: Noted. Sales will plan a soft-announce window the week after your confirmation.
omar: Also flagging CSM for dedicated tenants; we should run a short beta with 3 pilot customers for Dedicated when Console admin UI hits canary.
tony: Action items: 1) nina: finalize canary runs and post results 2026-09-03. 2) harper: sample guide draft 2026-08-01. 3) julia: rep one-pager 2026-07-20. 4) maya/tony: publish public timeline after 2026-09-10.
allhands-bot: Created checklist #8120 "All-hands roadmap followups" and assigned to maya, tony, nina, harper, julia. Due 2026-09-10.
maya: Thanks team. Short sync scheduled Friday 9:30am PT to close any unknowns. Please add any missing asks to the checklist. :calendar:
